resources.string: Search for a city below: the city, then the prefecture or state, then the country, so the right one of the world\'s many same-named places comes up. Home shows the line under its clock once Clean Your TV names this app in its weather_now key.
The first reading appears in a few seconds.
City, prefecture or state, country — e.g. Takizawa, Iwate, Japan
No place by that name. Add the prefecture or state and the country, in the spelling the map uses.
No answer from Open-Meteo. Check the TV\'s network and try again.

Weather from Open-Meteo (no key, no account). Clean Your TV reads the weather from the content provider this app publishes; the launcher itself never goes online. The reading refreshes when you open this screen, when Home asks for one older than 20 minutes, and on its own about every 20 minutes so the line is ready before Home looks. The request carries nothing but the coordinates.
